text.harness.css: Sizes the isolated graph regression viewport
text.index.html: Loads graph harness markup with production map styles
text.skills-extras-main.ts: Launches the Skills window harness's main process: the real extensions channels and the real skills listing, link and unlink over a temporary home and project folder, so every attach, move, detach and link writes real files
text.skills-extras-renderer.ts: Opens the real Skills modal on the harness page for the project it is given, with the shared tooltips installed
text.skills-extras.html: Loads the Skills modal markup with the production workspace and floating styles
text.integrations-main.ts: Launches the Integrations harness's main process: the real account service and IPC handlers with a fake cipher, pointed at a stub provider server and real git projects
text.integrations-main.ts gotcha: It accepts any frame as the workspace page, so the sender-frame guard is covered by the unit tests, not by this harness.
text.integrations-renderer.ts: Mounts an Integrations button and the real project chip in the status bar, both opening the real Integrations dialog, on the harness page for the projects it is given
text.integrations.html: Loads a sidebar with an Integrations button and a Lantern panel with a status bar, with the production chrome and Integrations styles
text.main.cjs: Launches isolated Electron graph fixtures with controlled viewport and pixel density
text.tray-popover-frame.html: Loads the real popover page with the production theme and popover styles inside the harness, which supplies its own bridge
text.tray-popover-main.cjs: Launches a hidden Electron window that holds the popover harness on a desktop backdrop
text.tray-popover-renderer.ts: Mounts the real popover view with a bridge that records the calls it makes and reports its height to the page around it, and lets the test open or update it with a model
text.tray-popover-shell.css: Paints a desktop and menu bar behind the popover and places the frame, a rounded translucent window, under the icon
text.tray-popover-shell.js: Resizes the frame to the height the popover reports
text.tray-popover.html: Holds the desktop backdrop and the frame that shows the popover page
text.renderer.ts: Mounts production graph views using deterministic or supplied map fixtures, and a pinned macro view with this repo's feature texts or a pinned areas payload on request, a stub explanation client for the review demo, a project name when asked, the Orchard Market evaluation project with its pull request, a small or large evaluation project, and a project sized by the areas and features in the address
